containment.scope: Rigid body envelopes in declared empty box cavities at home

exterior_containment.scope: Whole installation box enclosure by closed loft winding and complete triangle/OBB SAT; independent physical-wall clearance required.

hold.scope: Unsupported stance and explicit small disturbance only; not walking or thermal qualification.

roll_kick.scope: Unsupported stance and explicit small disturbance only; not walking or thermal qualification.

pitch_kick.scope: Unsupported stance and explicit small disturbance only; not walking or thermal qualification.

limitations: Unweighed component and shell allocations; installed mass and inertia need measurement.
Horn/idler geometry, bearings, fasteners, cable bend radii and structural deflection remain unqualified.
Sampled geometry separation is not continuous or exhaustive motion-clearance certification.
Ideal actuator simulation omits measured torque-speed, thermal, electrical, delay and backlash behavior.
No walking, fall recovery or fabricated prototype is certified by these screens.
Installation boxes are engineering allowances and require selected connector/cable CAD and hardware measurement.
Raw XL330 cases retain the full 20x34x26 mm dimensions; horns/idlers, bearings and shaft interfaces remain baseline approximations.
Air space does not demonstrate passive cooling, fan airflow or full simultaneous servo-load capability.
Service corridors are removal proposals; they require panel openings and independent service-pose verification.
Camera mass is an additional 8 g allowance; ribbon routing, on-robot operation and a clear optical aperture are not certified.
Appearance meshes represent concept geometry; skull walls model 1.2 mm nominal thickness, while fastening, ventilation and manufacturing CAD remain unqualified.
Skull and jaw replacement retain their existing assigned masses; new neck/leg/toe covers add explicit 12 g allowances.
Motor centers, joint axes/ranges, actuator settings and original sole collision footprints are unchanged by appearance generation.
A real 12 mm nose aperture clears the camera optical axis; the actual lens field of view, window material, ribbon bends and lens-to-window mount remain unqualified.
Body-local box inertia surrogates are used for small new covers, with explicit assigned mass rather than inferred material density.
Rear cap, panel flanges, fasteners and internal mounting frame are allocated in mass but need fabrication CAD.
The hip, shoulder and yaw apertures are open; joint covers must remain separate moving parts.
Reference caps establish exterior containment, not a fabricated closure over intentional joint and service openings.
Installed boxes must separately clear actual wall material and mechanisms by the declared clearance margin.

report_detail.retention_rule: All failing/incomplete pairs and the 100 smallest recorded distance bounds.
report_detail.full_report_omission: Passing pair witnesses outside that selection are omitted from this file only.
report_detail.regeneration: Rerun the recorded invocation with python -m examples.mini_tyrannosaurus_rex.juvenile.validate, omitting --compact.
